title: Payment confirmation timeout
symptoms: Intermittent confirmation latency above 8s, gateway retries, customer-facing pending state
resolution: Increase pool size. Add exponential backoff on confirmation.
summary: PaymentService confirmation path blocked when the MySQL connection pool of 50 was fully checked out. Confirmations timed out. Fix increased pool size and added exponential backoff.

title: Kafka partition assignment storm after deploy
failure: Consumers bounced after a settlement worker rollout
symptoms: Brief processing pause, partition revokes during deploy window
root_cause: Rolling deploy killed workers faster than session timeout
summary: Settlement workers were SIGTERM'd during a rolling deploy, causing a short partition assignment storm. Not a heartbeat misconfiguration.

title: Duplicate refund
symptoms: Same refund_id posted twice to ledger, merchant dispute
resolution: Add idempotency key on refund create and worker consume.
summary: RefundService accepted repeated POST bodies without an idempotency key, so Kafka retries created duplicate ledger entries.

title: API gateway timeout on capture
symptoms: Capture requests aborted at the edge while PaymentService still succeeded
root_cause: Gateway timeout lower than capture SLA
resolution: Align gateway timeout with capture budget.
summary: API Gateway cut capture calls at 3s while PaymentService capture legitimately took up to 5s.

title: Payment timeout
symptoms: Database waiters piled up, confirmation timeouts during sale window
resolution: Pool tuning plus statement timeout configuration.
summary: After the PostgreSQL migration, PaymentService still exhausted connections during a flash sale. Pool and statement timeouts were retuned.

title: Redis lock stampede on confirm
symptoms: Hot key on lock:payment:* during cricket final traffic
root_cause: Single Redis shard hot lock keyspace
resolution: Key hashing and shorter lock TTL.
summary: Confirmation locks concentrated on a Redis hot key during a traffic spike. Unrelated to SQL pool exhaustion.

title: Settlement reconciliation delayed
symptoms: Merchant settlement batches arrived hours late, consumer lag metric high
resolution: Increased max.poll.records and scaled settlement workers overnight.
summary: Settlement Kafka consumer lag grew because workers could not keep up with poll volume. Scaled consumers. Heartbeat/session timeout were not changed.

title: Duplicate merchant posting
symptoms: Reconciliation job replayed a batch after a crash
summary: Settlement reconciliation replayed an uncheckpointed batch after a worker crash.

title: Overnight batch delay from slow SQL
symptoms: Batch window overran, no consumer group instability
summary: Settlement SQL scans were slow due to a missing merchant_id index. Consumers were stable.

title: Refund worker timeout
failure: Refund worker timed out while posting to ledger
symptoms: Retries, delayed refund completion, no duplicates after INC-155 controls
resolution: Raised worker HTTP timeout and isolated ledger circuit breaker.
summary: Refund worker HTTP client timed out calling the ledger. Idempotency prevented duplicates.
